source.name: KPBS (Associated Press) – 'DirecTV signs multiyear deal to become jersey partner of San Diego FC'
source.quote: DirecTV has signed a multiyear deal to become the jersey partner of the San Diego FC, its first foray into kit sponsorship in MLS
source.note: Reports the deal; no value reported. Front of primary and secondary jerseys from the 2025 inaugural season; confirmed again for 2026 by the club's kit launch.

note: Front-of-kit ('Official Jersey Partner'), multi-year from July 2024. No reported value.
